Lionel Messi lost his temper in a playoff game… and the player he hit decided the match. Saturday, 21 November – MLS Cup Playoffs, Round One, Game 1: Inter Miami 0–3 Columbus Crew. At the stroke of half-time, with ten-man Miami trailing 1–0, Messi was preparing a throw-in. Columbus forward Gonzalo Tapia stood beside him to stop a quick restart. Messi pushed the ball against Tapia's face, and when Tapia jumped to block the throw, Messi threw the ball at his head from point-blank range. Referee Allen Chapman showed a yellow card to both players. Columbus coach Laurent Courtois said Messi should have been sent off. The twist: Tapia scored twice, a 9th-minute penalty and a 58th-minute goal, and Columbus won 3–0. It's best of three. Game 2 is on Friday 27 November in Columbus, and if Miami lose, they're out.
